upset.why: Jackie aCHANe banked 49.56 on Thursday. Sheev needs 106.8 from Sunday and Monday starters, with two Browns in the lowest total on the board, Jayden Daniels in a 40.5 game and Breece Hall questionable.

intro: Thursday night I had the Packers minus 3.5 and the under, and for once in my miserable life both cashed. Green Bay 27, Carolina 19. Chuba Hubbard put 24.9 on the board for Ben Football Team, Josh Jacobs gave Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 23.2, and Jordan Love (22.52) and Christian Watson (17.3) handed brimley 39.82 before anybody else played a down. The big winner was Jackie aCHANe: Matthew Golden 20.9, Tucker Kraft 17.3, Bryce Young 11.36, 49.56 banked, the most in the league. Sheev got 11.8 from Tetairoa McMillan and Panic Trade Project got 9.6 from Jalen Coker.

Same system as always. Every Sunday and Monday starter gets the Vegas implied total for his offense, built from the spread and the total. I took the boards from FOX Sports (bet365) and VegasInsider's consensus, both posted Friday, and lined them up. They agree on every favorite. Where they were a half point apart I split the difference, so you'll see Dallas -6.75 and a 46 total in Detroit. Thursday points are already in the bank, so the Vegas environment in each strip only counts the guys who still have to play.

The board in one breath. Dallas is implied for 30.6 against Arizona in a 54.5 total, the fattest number of the week. Cincinnati is 29.5 as a 12.5-point favorite over Tennessee, Buffalo 28.9 against Baltimore in the other 54.5 game, Jacksonville 28.4 laying 10.25 to Indianapolis. The sewer: Tennessee at 17, Philadelphia at 17.4 with Tanner McKee at quarterback, Cleveland at 17.75 in a 39 total at Pittsburgh, the lowest total on the board, then Indianapolis at 18.1 and Miami at 18.4. Houston, the Giants, New Orleans and San Francisco are on bye, which is why Brock Purdy and C.J. Stroud are on Sheev's bench, Christian McCaffrey is on Bijan's, Chris Olave is on Stroke The Post's, and Nico Collins and George Kittle are on God Bless Vodka's. Bears at Seahawks closes it out Monday night.

sections.note: #StopAsianHate. Lamar Jackson is back in a 54.5 total, Jaxon Smith-Njigba projects 25.22 on Monday, and four starters play in offenses implied for 25-plus to Ben's one.
p: Ben Football Team is 5-2, tied for second, and seventh in points per game at 122.5. #StopAsianHate is 3-4, fifth in scoring at 152.2, with the third-toughest schedule and a luck factor of -2.0. One of these records is built on luck, +2.27 of it, and it isn't the 3-4 one. Ben banked 24.9 from Hubbard on Thursday, and #StopAsianHate still projects 166.5 to 140.6.

The reason is Lamar Jackson. He's expected to play after missing three games with the ankle, and Baltimore is implied for 25.6 in Buffalo in a 54.5 total. Sleeper has him at 20.5, and Zay Flowers (18.45) comes with him in the same game. Kenneth Walker III projects 20.64 in Denver. Rhamondre Stevenson (15.64) gets the New England backfield with TreVeyon Henderson out, New England implied for 25.1 in Miami. Rashee Rice is off the injury report and back in the lineup at 12.6. Then Monday night, Jaxon Smith-Njigba gets the Bears at 25.22 projected, the highest projection of any receiver in the league this week.

The worry is George Pickens. He's questionable with the shoulder and hamstring and was limited all week, though Dallas expects him to play if he's healthy. Dallas is implied for 30.6, the best number on the board, and KaVontae Turpin is out. If Pickens is active, that's free money. If he isn't, #StopAsianHate has Ladd McConkey (11.08) on the bench and the Chargers at 19.25. Not the end of the world.

Ben's problem is the quarterback environment. Jared Goff (15.64) gets Minnesota with Detroit at 24.6, but Patrick Mahomes (16.81) is in Denver in a 40.5 total, Kansas City implied for 21. DK Metcalf and Denzel Boston are on opposite sides of Browns-Steelers, the 39-point game. Chris Godwin Jr. gets more looks with Emeka Egbuka out, and Bhayshul Tuten is Ben's only starter in a 25-plus offense, Jacksonville at 28.4. Ben has the 24.9 head start. #StopAsianHate has the better offenses. I'm laying 25.9 and I'm betting the watch I got from my second ex-wife.

sections.note: Jackie aCHANe. 49.56 is already banked, and Sheev needs 106.8 from a lineup with two Browns in a 39 total, Jayden Daniels in a 40.5 total and a questionable Breece Hall.
p: Yes, I'm fading the commissioner. Again. Sheev is 1-6 with the worst luck factor in the league, -3.27, and I feel for the man, I do. But the bookie doesn't have feelings, the bookie has a spreadsheet. Sheev projects 118.6 to 115.4, a 3.2-point favorite, which makes Jackie aCHANe the underdog, and I'm taking the dog.

Start with the bank. Jackie got 49.56 on Thursday from Golden, Kraft and Bryce Young. Sheev got 11.8. So the real question is whether Sheev's remaining starters can beat Jackie's by 37.8 points. Sleeper says they will, 106.8 to 65.8. Now look at where those 106.8 points are playing. Quinshon Judkins (10.74) and Harold Fannin Jr. (10.61) are Browns, and Cleveland is implied for 17.75 in Pittsburgh in a 39 total, the lowest total of the week. Jayden Daniels (18.4) gets the Eagles in a 40.5 total, tied for the second-lowest. That's three Sheev starters and 39.8 projected points in the two ugliest games on the board.

Then there's Breece Hall. He's questionable with the quad, he was limited all week, and he's missed four straight games. If he plays, he's on a pitch count. If he doesn't, Sheev has no running back on the bench with a Sleeper projection, and Kyle Monangai is out Monday. Zach Charbonnet (8.09) and Luther Burden III (12.38) play Monday night in Seattle, so Sheev's last 20 points come after everybody else's games are done.

Jackie's path is simple. Kyler Murray (17.05) is in Detroit, where the Vikings are implied for 21.4. Chris Rodriguez Jr. and Jakobi Meyers are in the Jacksonville offense at 28.4, and a 10.25-point favorite runs the ball in the fourth quarter, which is Rodriguez's whole job. Meyers is questionable with the hamstring and ankle, so check that inactive list. Wan'Dale Robinson gets more targets with Carnell Tate out in Tennessee. Sheev has the better roster. Jackie has the lead and the better games. Give me the dog and a cold one.

sections.note: Bijan Your Face 🍆💦. Josh Allen, Dak Prescott, Tee Higgins and Hunter Henry are all in offenses implied for 25-plus, and Very Naughty Boys starts Tanner McKee in a 17.4 offense.
p: Seven and oh against oh and seven. Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 scores 186.1 a game, first in the league. Very Naughty Boys scores 89.3, last. Bijan already banked 23.2 from Josh Jacobs. This one projects 184.7 to 105.2, and the 79.5 is the biggest number I'll lay all day.

Bijan's lineup is a Vegas map. Josh Allen (24.47) is home against Baltimore, Buffalo implied for 28.9. Dak Prescott (22.45) is home against Arizona, Dallas implied for 30.6. Tee Higgins (15.97) is in the Cincinnati offense at 29.5. Hunter Henry (11.39) gets the targets A.J. Brown left behind, because Brown is out and New England is implied for 25.1. Bijan Robinson (22.14) gets the Atlanta backfield to himself with Brian Robinson Jr. out. Bijan Your Face 🍆💦's 25.3 average environment is the best in the league this week.

Very Naughty Boys starts Tanner McKee (13.24) for an Eagles team implied for 17.4 that is missing DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks. Sam Darnold (16.3) plays Monday. Dalton Kincaid (10.47) is questionable with the chest. And here's the one that hurts: RJ Harvey is out in Denver, J.K. Dobbins is expected to get most of the carries, and Dobbins (8.64) is on the Very Naughty Boys bench while Dylan Sampson (6.51) starts in Cleveland's 17.75 offense. Jonah Coleman (11.58) is the Denver back in the lineup. Fix it or don't. Seventy-nine points is seventy-nine points.

sections.note: Stroke The Post. CeeDee Lamb and Javonte Williams are in the 30.6 Dallas offense, and Panic starts four players projected under 6.
p: Panic Trade Project is 4-3 while scoring 95.2 a game, 11th in the league, with a luck factor of +2.45, the best in the league. Stroke The Post is 4-3 while scoring 170.8, third. One of those records is lying. Panic banked 9.6 from Jalen Coker and still projects 83.9 to 166.6. That's the biggest spread on the board.

Stroke's best argument is a Dallas stack without a quarterback. CeeDee Lamb (21.95) and Javonte Williams (19.55) are both in the 30.6 Dallas offense against Arizona. James Cook III (17.33) is home against Baltimore, Buffalo at 28.9. Matthew Stafford (16.14) gets the Chargers, Rams at 25.75. D'Andre Swift (14.69) gets the Chicago backfield Monday night with Kyle Monangai out.

Panic is starting Tyler Goodson (5.97), Keaton Mitchell (5.82), Eli Raridon (5.88) and Ja'Kobi Lane (5.89). Goodson, Raridon and Lane are in good offenses and still project under 6, which tells you how small the roles are. Bo Nix (14.02) is home against Kansas City in a 40.5 total. Emeka Egbuka, Carnell Tate and Tyjae Spears are out, and Jaxson Dart is on IR. Panic also traded Terrance Ferguson to Stroke on Friday for a 2027 second. Ferguson is on IR, so he doesn't play in this one either. I'm laying 82.7 and sleeping like a baby.

sections.note: brimley. 39.82 is already banked, and ClutchJuice is starting a running back projected for 1.89.
p: brimley has won three straight and banked 39.82 on Thursday from Jordan Love and Christian Watson. ClutchJuice is 3-4 with the best lineup efficiency in the league, 97%, which is a fancy way of saying it starts the right guys and the right guys still score 98.2 a game. It projects 167.3 to 88.0.

The environments are even, 22.9 to 22.8, so this is about talent, not Vegas. Trevor Lawrence (20.4) is home against Indianapolis, Jacksonville at 28.4. Trey McBride (18.59) is in the 54.5 total in Dallas. Justin Jefferson (17.6) is in Detroit. Bucky Irving (16.61) gets more of the Tampa offense with Egbuka out, and Tony Pollard (14.75) gets the Tennessee backfield with Spears out, even if Tennessee is implied for 17. DJ Moore (14.03) is questionable with the shoulder but practiced Friday in a non-contact jersey. Jacoby Brissett (18.44) is on the bench, which is a nice problem to have.

ClutchJuice has Drake Maye (21.63) in Miami, New England implied for 25.1, but Brown is out, so Maye is throwing to Hunter Henry and whoever else is open. Rashod Bateman (5.63) is in the 54.5 Baltimore game with Lamar back. After that it's Isaiah Davis at 1.89 and Braelon Allen at 9.97, two Jets backs, and Breece Hall is questionable for the same team. If Hall plays, Davis is a ghost. Lay it.

sections.note: Send Nudes. Joe Burrow and Ja'Marr Chase are in the 29.5 Cincinnati offense, and five starters play in 25-plus offenses to God Bless Vodka's two.
p: The champs lost last week as an 82.5-point favorite, and I'm laying 54.5 with them anyway, because I learn nothing. Send Nudes is 5-2 and scores 171.0 a game, second in the league. God Bless Vodka is 2-5 and scores 104.2. This projects 171.1 to 116.6.

Puka Nacua (21.81) is off the injury report and Kyren Williams (19.78) is in the same Rams offense at 25.75. Derrick Henry (16.1) gets Lamar Jackson back in a 54.5 total. Jahmyr Gibbs (23.33) is in Detroit. Tyler Warren (11.09) isn't on the Colts' final report, so he plays.

God Bless Vodka's best shot is the same Bengals game. Chase Brown (17.88) runs for the 29.5 offense, and Jake Ferguson (9.12) is in Dallas at 30.6. Jeremiyah Love (10.42) isn't on Arizona's final injury report after missing two games, so he's back. But the quarterbacks are Geno Smith (17.37) against Las Vegas and Cam Ward (13.29) in Tennessee, implied for 17, the lowest number on the board. Justin Herbert (13.57) is on the bench with the Chargers at 19.25, so there's no fix there either. Send Nudes, and I'm not sweating it. Much.

stories.headline: Lamar Is Cleared, A.J. Brown Is Out, and Breece Hall Is Still a Question
paragraphs: Good morning. Every inactive list comes out about 90 minutes before its kickoff, and Bears-Seahawks waits until Monday night. The final reports came out Friday. As always, a designation tells you the risk. It doesn't tell you who sits.

The big news is a return. Lamar Jackson (#StopAsianHate) is expected to play in Buffalo after missing three games with his ankle injury. Baltimore is implied for about 25.6 in a 54.5 total. That's an upgrade for Derrick Henry (Send Nudes), Zay Flowers (#StopAsianHate), Ja'Kobi Lane (Panic Trade Project) and Rashod Bateman (ClutchJuice). Rashee Rice (#StopAsianHate) is off Kansas City's report and returns from his hamstring injury in Denver. Puka Nacua (Send Nudes) is off the Rams' report after last week's calf scare. Tyler Warren (Send Nudes) is not on Indianapolis's final report, and neither is Jeremiyah Love (God Bless Vodka) on Arizona's after two missed games with his ankle. Love's return pushes Tyler Allgeier (God Bless Vodka bench) back to the backup role.

New England is thinner. A.J. Brown (Send Nudes bench) is out with knee and ankle injuries, and TreVeyon Henderson (Sheev bench) is out with an illness. Rhamondre Stevenson (#StopAsianHate) gets the backfield. Drake Maye (ClutchJuice) loses his top receiver, which should send more targets to Hunter Henry (Bijan Your Face 🍆💦), DeMario Douglas (Very Naughty Boys) and Eli Raridon (Panic Trade Project).

Jalen Hurts (#StopAsianHate) remains on injured reserve, so Tanner McKee (Very Naughty Boys) starts again in Washington, and Philadelphia is implied for only 17.4. The Eagles are also without DeVonta Smith (Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 IR) and Dontayvion Wicks (Very Naughty Boys), which leaves Makai Lemon (Panic Trade Project) and Dallas Goedert (#StopAsianHate) as the main targets. In Tampa, Emeka Egbuka (Panic Trade Project) is out with his foot injury again, which helps Chris Godwin Jr. (Ben Football Team) and Bucky Irving (brimley). In Tennessee, Tyjae Spears and Carnell Tate (both Panic Trade Project) are out, so Tony Pollard (brimley) and Wan'Dale Robinson (Jackie aCHANe) should see more work, though the Titans are implied for just 17.

Backfields. RJ Harvey (#StopAsianHate) is out for Denver, and J.K. Dobbins is expected to get most of the carries. Dobbins is on the Very Naughty Boys bench while Jonah Coleman, the other Denver back, starts. Brian Robinson Jr. (brimley bench) is out again, which leaves Atlanta to Bijan Robinson. Kyle Monangai (Sheev bench) is out for Monday night with thumb and toe injuries, which helps D'Andre Swift (Stroke The Post).

The questionable list. Breece Hall (Sheev) is questionable with the quad strain and was limited all week. If he's active, expect a reduced role, and that matters for Braelon Allen and Isaiah Davis (both ClutchJuice), who start in the same backfield. George Pickens (#StopAsianHate) is questionable with shoulder and hamstring injuries after limited practices all week; Dallas expects him to play if he's healthy, and Dallas is implied for 30.6, the highest on the board. DJ Moore (brimley) and Dalton Kincaid (Very Naughty Boys) are both questionable for Buffalo and practiced Friday in non-contact jerseys. Jakobi Meyers (Jackie aCHANe) is questionable with hamstring and ankle injuries. Jaylen Waddle (Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 bench) is questionable with a chest injury in Denver. Christian Watson (brimley) carried a questionable tag into Thursday and scored 17.3, so that one is settled.

Lineup check: no league starter this morning is ruled out or on a bye. There are five questionable starters: Hall, Pickens, Moore, Kincaid and Meyers. Hall and Meyers are the two I'd want a pivot for. The Saints, Giants, 49ers and Texans are on bye, so the injured players there, including Christian McCaffrey (Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 bench), David Montgomery and Woody Marks (both Jackie aCHANe bench), don't matter this week.

stories.headline: Buyer’s Remorse Week
paragraphs: Last Thursday this column opened on a $37 bid. This week the whole league spent $32. Fifteen claims have cleared since our last edition, seven of them in Wednesday's run for $18, and the biggest winning bid was $6. Nobody broke the bank. What I'm hearing instead is a lot of teams undoing last week's decisions.

Start with Stroke The Post. Earlier this month it cut Michael Mayer and paid $12 for Tua Tagovailoa. On Wednesday it released Tua, who never started a game for Stroke and is now listed third on Atlanta's depth chart, and paid $5 for Elijah Mitchell, Philadelphia's third running back, projected for 2.01 points this week. That's $17 for two backups who have combined for zero points in Stroke's lineup. Stroke still has $64, the fifth-most in the league, so it can absorb it, but at 4-3 that money should be waiting for a starter.

The most contested player of the week was Chig Okonkwo, and he's now on his third league roster this season. Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 dropped him in Week 2. Panic Trade Project claimed him for $0 on Saturday and cut him Sunday morning for Tyler Goodson. Then four teams bid Wednesday: Send Nudes won at $6 over #StopAsianHate ($2), brimley ($1) and ClutchJuice ($0). Send Nudes also paid $4 for Colby Parkinson, uncontested. Here's my problem with it. To make room, the champs cut Pat Freiermuth, who projects 9.42 this week against Cleveland, more than Okonkwo (7.38) or Parkinson (6.66, questionable). I get the logic, since Tyler Warren is questionable with a groin injury and Send Nudes wanted cover. But it spent $10 on two tight ends who both project below the one it released, and Freiermuth had only scored 3.1 and 4.0 in his two starts for them. Send Nudes cut Christian Kirk for Parkinson, too, and has $94.

Then there are the U-turns. Jackie aCHANe dropped Ty Johnson last Thursday to claim Zonovan Knight for $3, then bought Johnson back on Monday for $2 and cut Jaleel McLaughlin. Both start Sunday, Knight at 7.42 and Johnson at 5.3. Knight is my best value of the week: $3, 9.3 points in his Week 7 start, and he starts again in Arizona's game with Dallas, which has the highest total on the board at 54.5. Sheev paid $5 for Roschon Johnson last Thursday, started him for 1.3 points, and on Wednesday swapped him for Josh Cameron at $0. To make room for Roschon, Sheev had cut CJ Donaldson, whom it paid $3 in FAAB to acquire in a Week 6 trade. Sheev is down to $10.

Panic had the busiest week. Besides the Okonkwo round trip, it picked up Pierre Strong Jr. as a free agent Sunday, started him for 0.0, and on Wednesday cut him for Devin Singletary at $3. Singletary is the Giants' third running back, and the Giants are on bye. Its $0 claim on Jalen McMillan failed for lack of roster space. Panic has $14. #StopAsianHate paid $1 for Tyler Higbee on Friday, started him for 3.4 points and released him Tuesday. That makes four league teams Higbee has been on this season: Bijan, brimley, Ben Football Team and #StopAsianHate. He's a free agent again and projects 8.43.

ClutchJuice did the most with the least. It added Cooper Kupp and Kalif Raymond for $0 on Wednesday, cut Ray Davis, and both go straight into the lineup, Kupp in the superflex slot at 7.46 and Raymond at flex at 7.17. That tells you how thin it is: with Anthony Richardson Sr. and Tyson Bagent unprojected, Drake Maye is its only quarterback with a number. It also swapped Kevin Coleman Jr. for Jordan Watkins at $0. Elsewhere, Bijan paid $3 for Baltimore running back Justice Hill, beating Jackie's $1, and has $67 left. Its Saturday claims on Goodson and Brandin Cooks failed for roster space. God Bless Vodka claimed Cincinnati receiver Dohnte Meyers for $0.

Who has money left: God Bless Vodka $96, Send Nudes $94, brimley $74, Bijan $67, Stroke $64 and Ben $63. Then #StopAsianHate $37, Very Naughty Boys $26, Panic $14, Sheev $10, and Jackie and ClutchJuice at $9 each. Three of the top six budgets belong to the league's top three teams: Bijan, Send Nudes and Ben. If a starter goes down this weekend, God Bless Vodka, at 2-5, has the most to bid.

stories.headline: Byes in Houston and San Francisco, a 5-2 Underdog, and a Playoff Line on the Line
paragraphs: No picks here. Jeff Longwood makes those Sunday, after the injury report settles. This is the scouting file for Week 8. Houston, New Orleans, the Giants and San Francisco are on bye, and the team that feels it is Sheev. Both of its veteran quarterbacks, C.J. Stroud and Brock Purdy, are off, and Tyler Huntley has no projection, so Sheev starts tight end Brenton Strange in its superflex slot. No other league team has a starter on bye as of Thursday morning.

Tonight it's Carolina at Green Bay. The Packers are 3.5-point favorites and the total is 47.5, which implies 25.5 points for Green Bay and 22 for Carolina. Nine league starters play. Jackie aCHANe has three, Bryce Young, Matthew Golden and Tucker Kraft. brimley has Jordan Love and Christian Watson. Bijan has Josh Jacobs, Ben Football Team has Chuba Hubbard, Panic Trade Project has Jalen Coker, and Sheev has Tetairoa McMillan. Golden is questionable with a shoulder injury.

Follow the implied totals. Dallas is a 7-point favorite over Arizona with a 54.5 total, which implies 30.75 points, the most of the week. Buffalo (28.75, favored by 3 over Baltimore in the other 54.5-point game), Cincinnati (28.25, favored by 10 over Tennessee) and Jacksonville (28.0, favored by 9.5 over Indianapolis) are next. The bottom of the board is Philadelphia at 17.5, a 5.5-point underdog to Washington, then Cleveland at 18.0, and Miami and Tennessee at 18.25. Send Nudes has six starters in offenses implied for 25 or more and the highest average, 24.85. Panic has one, and its starters average 20.88, the lowest in the league. Our sources disagree on the favorite in Las Vegas at the Jets, so we treat it as a pick'em.

The game of the week is #StopAsianHate against Ben Football Team, because the 5-2 team is the projected underdog by 29.0. Ben is tied for the second-best record in the league, but it has scored 122.5 a game, seventh in the league, and its opponents have averaged 114.1, the softest schedule anyone has played. By all-play, Ben has played like a 2.73-win team. #StopAsianHate is 3-4 but has played like a 5-win team, and it just scored a season-high 173.12. The gap is receiver, 70.5 to 32.3, behind Jaxon Smith-Njigba's 25.03, the top projection in the league. Ben's answer is tight end, where Hockenson and LaPorta give it a 12.1-point edge. Watch the injury report: Lamar Jackson, George Pickens and Rashee Rice are all questionable for #StopAsianHate, and Ladd McConkey (11.01, questionable) is on its bench. Ben and Stroke The Post are the only teams with no questionable starters.

Now the playoff line. Six teams get in. Bijan is 7-0, Send Nudes and Ben are 5-2, and four teams are 4-3: Stroke, brimley, Jackie and Panic. Jackie holds sixth on points, with Panic seventh. Jackie plays Sheev in the closest projected game of the week, 120.2 to 104.7 for Sheev. Jackie has the edge at quarterback by 17.4, thanks to Sheev's byes, but its running backs project 12.7, the second-lowest group in the league, and it starts Zachariah Branch (2.93) at flex with Jakobi Meyers (10.18, questionable) on the bench. Jackie has also set the least efficient lineups in the league, 78% of its optimal points. Sheev is the unluckiest team in the league by all-play and has faced the toughest schedule, opponents averaging 150.8. Panic draws Stroke and projects 103.2 to 163.2, a 50.2-point gap at running back alone. Panic is 4-3 while averaging 95.2 points, the second-lowest in the league, and it's the luckiest team by all-play.

The rest of the slate is lopsided on paper. Bijan projects 178.1, the best of the week, against Very Naughty Boys' 101.8, and its quarterbacks, Josh Allen (24.43) and Dak Prescott (22.67), are the top two quarterback projections in any lineup. Four Bijan starters are questionable, Brock Bowers again among them, but Hunter Henry (9.37) and Michael Mayer (7.47) are on the bench. Send Nudes projects 175.1 against God Bless Vodka's 116.3, but its four questionable starters, Jahmyr Gibbs, Ja'Marr Chase, A.J. Brown and Tyler Warren, carry 68.94 points, the most at risk anywhere. And ClutchJuice projects 82.5, the lowest of the week, against brimley's 157.9. ClutchJuice's best hope is that brimley's defense keeps doing what it does: brimley has allowed 166.0 a game, the most in the league.

Ben Football Team leads at tight end by 12.1 with T.J. Hockenson and Sam LaPorta. stories.headline: One Snap, One Point, and a Bench Nobody Needed: How Week 8 Was Decided
intro: The league averaged 133.87 points in Week 8, down 3.26 from Week 7. Send Nudes' 211.96 was the top score, the fourth-highest by any team this season, and Panic Trade Project's 72.68 was the lowest, its own season low. Favorites won four of six games. One of the two that didn't was decided by 1.18 points, and the other on Baltimore's first offensive snap.

Bijan Your Face is 8-0 and the only unbeaten team left. Send Nudes and Ben Football Team are 6-2. Stroke The Post, brimley and Jackie aCHANe are 5-3, and Jackie holds the sixth and final playoff spot on the tiebreaker despite the eighth-most points in the league. Panic Trade Project is a game back at 4-4. Six weeks remain in the regular season. Here is every game.

p: Jackie aCHANe beat Sheev 116.86 to 115.68. That 1.18-point margin is the third-closest game of the season. Sheev was a 3.2-point favorite on Sunday's lineup projections, and Jeff Longwood took Jackie as his upset of the week. He got it.

Jackie built the win on Thursday night in Green Bay. Matthew Golden scored 20.9, Tucker Kraft 17.3 and Bryce Young 11.36, and Jackie went into Sunday with 49.56 points to Sheev's 11.8. Kyler Murray added 20.9 and Wan'Dale Robinson 15.7. Jackie could have made it easier: Malik Willis scored 15.64 on the bench while Young started, and Justice Hill, a $4 waiver claim this week, scored 7.5 on the bench while Kendrick Bourne started and scored 3.9.

Sheev came back on Monday night. Luther Burden III scored 18.6 for the Bears against Seattle, the most points by any player in that game on either roster, and Zach Charbonnet added 5.9, against 4.3 from Jackie's AJ Barner. It came up 1.18 short. Here is the detail that hurts: Sheev's lineup was the best it could legally field. The only bench player who scored, Oronde Gadsden with 10.2, is on the taxi squad and couldn't be started. Harold Fannin Jr. scored 23.4 and Pat Freiermuth, a $0 waiver claim that Send Nudes had dropped in Week 7, scored 11.6. Parker Washington scored 3.6 against a 15.48 projection, and that was the game. One more thing: Sheev dropped Courtland Sutton for Tank Dell this week. Dell scored 0.0 on Sheev's bench. Sutton scored 9.3 on Send Nudes' bench.
sections.note: Sheev is 1-7 with the sixth-most points in the league and the worst luck rating, -3.55. Jackie aCHANe is 5-3 and holds sixth. Next week: Sheev plays ClutchJuice, Jackie plays brimley.

p: Ben Football Team beat #StopAsianHate 130.58 to 112.96. #StopAsianHate was a 25.9-point favorite and Jeff's game of the week pick. It was the only pick Jeff lost.

Lamar Jackson hurt his right thumb on Baltimore's first play in Buffalo, when his hand hit a pass rusher as he threw. He played one snap and scored 0.0 in #StopAsianHate's superflex spot. The Ravens say he is headed for surgery and injured reserve. Baltimore's backup, Tyler Huntley, hurt his toe in the second quarter, the Bills won 36-10, and Zay Flowers scored 0.0 against an 18.45 projection. That is 38.95 projected points from one offense that turned into nothing. George Pickens added 6.8.

Lamar's injury could not have been planned for. The rest could have been. Kenny Gainwell scored 14.0 on the bench, Blake Corum 13.3 and Ladd McConkey 12.6. Swap Gainwell in for Flowers and McConkey in for Pickens, leave Lamar's zero exactly where it was, and #StopAsianHate wins 132.76 to 130.58. Jaxon Smith-Njigba scored 23.8 on Monday night and Jaylen Warren 21.3.

Ben Football Team won while leaving 52.9 points on its own bench, the most in the league this week. Adonai Mitchell scored 27.2 and Emmett Johnson 25.3 on the bench, while Chris Godwin Jr. scored 0.0 and DK Metcalf 1.4 in the lineup. It didn't matter, because Bhayshul Tuten scored 29.9 against Indianapolis, Patrick Mahomes 25.44 and Chuba Hubbard 24.9.
sections.note: Ben Football Team is 6-2 with the seventh-most points in the league and a +2.64 luck rating, tied with Jackie aCHANe for the best. #StopAsianHate is 3-5 and two games out of sixth, and its quarterback room now has a hole in it.

p: Bijan Your Face beat Very Naughty Boys 199.56 to 135.2, and it is 8-0. Tee Higgins scored 37.5 against Tennessee on a 15.97 projection. Brock Bowers scored 28.2, Josh Allen 27.56 against Baltimore, Michael Wilson 26.8 and Josh Jacobs 23.2 on Thursday night. Bijan Robinson, the team's namesake, scored 7.6 against a 22.14 projection, and it didn't matter. Jaylen Waddle (14.9) and Ryan Flournoy (13.1) both outscored him from the bench.

Very Naughty Boys scored 135.2, its best score of the season by 20.78 points, and it wasn't close to enough. Jonah Coleman scored 20.4, Dalton Kincaid 18.6 and Sam Darnold 18.52. Very Naughty Boys did cover Jeff's 79.5-point line, which is the kind of moral victory you get at 0-8.
sections.note: Bijan Your Face has scored 1,502.5 points, 93.7 more than anyone else, and averages 187.8 a week. Very Naughty Boys is 0-8, the only winless team. Next week Bijan plays God Bless Vodka; Very Naughty Boys gets Send Nudes.

p: Send Nudes beat God Bless Vodka 211.96 to 116.96, the week's top score. Joe Burrow scored 42.48 against Tennessee, the most by any player in the league this week, and Ja'Marr Chase added 31.1. That's 73.58 points from one Cincinnati passing game. Kirk Cousins scored 28.18, Puka Nacua 25.0 and Jahmyr Gibbs 24.8.

Last week Send Nudes lost with Cousins on its bench. This week Cousins started over Aaron Rodgers, who scored 5.88 on the bench, and Send Nudes set a perfect lineup: 211.96 out of a possible 211.96. The only soft spot was Tyler Warren, 5.8 against an 11.09 projection.

God Bless Vodka had its own Tennessee day. Cam Ward scored 26.26 against Cincinnati on a 13.29 projection. Then there was the bench. Tyler Allgeier scored 36.1 on it, more than any running back in a starting lineup in the league this week, while Jeremiyah Love started in his first game back from his ankle injury and scored 2.3. Jake Ferguson, now listed out with an ankle injury, started and scored 0.0. God Bless Vodka left 43.8 points on the bench. The best lineup it could have set scores 160.76, which would still have lost by 51.2.
sections.note: Send Nudes is 6-2, second in the league on the points tiebreaker over Ben Football Team. God Bless Vodka is 2-6.

stories.headline: Jeff Longwood Went 5-1, Lamar Played One Snap, and I Have Some Apologizing to Do
paragraphs: I have to start with an apology, and I hate it. Last week I said the toilet bowl was officially Jeff Longwood. This week Jeff went 5-1. His upset pick, Jackie aCHANe over the commissioner, hit by 1.18 points. His lock, Bijan Your Face, won by 64.36. The only pick he lost was #StopAsianHate, and he lost it because a quarterback got hurt on the first play of the game. Jeff, I'm sorry. Please stop texting me screenshots.

Let's talk about that first play. Lamar Jackson came back from three missed games, Dr. Wang cleared him, he played, and he lasted exactly one snap before his thumb hit a Buffalo pass rusher. He scored 0.0. Zay Flowers scored 0.0. #StopAsianHate lost by 17.62 with Kenny Gainwell's 14.0 and Ladd McConkey's 12.6 on the bench. I can't blame anyone for the thumb. I can blame someone for George Pickens' 6.8 starting over McConkey, and I will.

Ben Football Team left 52.9 points on its bench, the most in the league, and won anyway. Adonai Mitchell scored 27.2 on the bench. Emmett Johnson scored 25.3 on the bench. Chris Godwin Jr. scored 0.0 in the lineup. This team is 6-2 with the seventh-most points in the league, and Jackie aCHANe is 5-3 with the eighth-most. Both have a +2.64 luck rating, best in the league. Panic Trade Project has the fewest points in the league and is 4-4. Somebody check the schedule-maker's bank account.

Speaking of which, the commissioner. Sheev lost by 1.18 with the best lineup it could legally set. Nothing on the bench could have saved it. Sheev also dropped Courtland Sutton this week to pick up Tank Dell. Dell scored zero. Sutton scored 9.3 for Send Nudes, on the bench, because Send Nudes has so much depth it doesn't need him. Sheev is 1-7 with the sixth-most points in the league and the worst luck rating in the league, -3.55. Next week it plays ClutchJuice, which just scored 85.56. I said this last week too. I'm saying it again. Win the game, Commissioner.

Two quick ones. God Bless Vodka benched Tyler Allgeier, and Allgeier scored 36.1, more than any running back who actually started in this league. Jeremiyah Love, who started instead, scored 2.3. And the Bengals: Joe Burrow scored 42.48 and Ja'Marr Chase 31.1 for Send Nudes, and Tee Higgins scored 37.5 for Bijan Your Face. Three Bengals combined for 111.08 points against Tennessee, and the two teams that own them both won. Next week Bijan plays God Bless Vodka. God Bless Vodka should start Allgeier. It won't matter, but it should.

breakdown.headline: 1-5, the Worst Luck in the League, and Up to Third
p: Sheev is 1-5 and third in dynasty value, up three spots to 69,030. Both numbers are correct. The team scores 150.4 a game, fifth in the league, against the third-toughest schedule. Its all-play record is 3.82 wins and its luck factor is -2.82, the worst in the league. Put this lineup against the league average every week and it's closer to 4-2.

The value gain is real and mostly cheap. Isaiah Likely (3,341) gained 546 and C.J. Stroud (4,466) gained 542. The waiver wire added three players: Tank Dell (1,243) for $1 after Panic Trade Project dropped him, Courtland Sutton (1,178) for $11 and Roschon Johnson (614) for $5. Harold Fannin Jr. lost 311.

It's a young roster. Forty-eight percent of the value is in players 25 or younger, 2% is in players 29 or older, and the weighted age is 24.9. It has three starting-caliber quarterbacks in Brock Purdy (6,268), Jayden Daniels (5,505) and Stroud, plus Tetairoa McMillan (4,860), Luther Burden III (3,369) and Jordyn Tyson on the taxi squad.

The problem is the 2027 first. Sheev's own pick belongs to Very Naughty Boys, and at 1-5 it projects early, worth 5,103. Its 2028 first belongs to ClutchJuice. In exchange, Sheev holds Ben Football Team's 2027 first (projected late), #StopAsianHate's 2028 first and second, and Bijan's 2028 third, 7,296 in pick value, seventh.
breakdown.verdict: A good young roster having a bad-luck season, and every loss makes Very Naughty Boys' pick better.
breakdown.move: Keep buying, because losing doesn't help Sheev. Trade one of the three quarterbacks for a starting running back so Breece Hall's quad stops deciding the week.

breakdown.headline: 1-5 and Rebuilding, but the First-Round Picks Belong to Someone Else
p: God Bless Vodka is 1-5 with five straight losses, scores 103.7 a game, ninth, and fell two spots to 11th in dynasty value at 50,653. The projected win total is 3.6.

The diagnosis is the draft capital. God Bless Vodka's 2027 first and second belong to Bijan, and its 2028 first and fourth belong to Jackie aCHANe. With this record, that 2027 first projects early, and Bijan is the one who gets it. What's left: its own 2027 third, its own 2028 second and third, and Jackie aCHANe's 2028 second, 4,948 in pick value, 11th.

The roster is in mixed health. Jeremiyah Love (5,291), 21, is the most valuable player on the roster and is out with his ankle again. Omarion Hampton (3,310) and Justin Herbert (3,921) are on the bench during the Chargers' bye. Nico Collins (4,531), 27, and George Kittle (2,878), 33, are veterans on a team that won't contend this year. Jaylin Noel gained 338 this week; Chase Brown lost 320.
On Monday it sold Austin Ekeler to Very Naughty Boys for a 2027 fourth. Forty-four percent of the value is in players 25 or younger.
breakdown.verdict: A rebuild without its own first-round picks, which means losing doesn't help it.
breakdown.move: Sell Kittle and Collins now, for 2027 firsts from contenders. Losing only helps Bijan.

breakdown.headline: Still Second, Oldest in the League, and Losing Value Fastest
p: Here's what I'm hearing around the league: nobody wants to see Send Nudes in December. They shouldn't. The champs are 5-2, second in scoring at 171.0 a game, and project for 10.9 wins. They're also second in dynasty value at 70,613, and they lost 3,012 since last Sunday, the biggest drop of any team in the league.

The drop is the price of an old roster. A.J. Brown fell 449 and is out this week, Derrick Henry fell 393 at 32.8 years old, and even Jahmyr Gibbs gave back 342. Thirty-seven percent of the value sits in players 29 or older, the highest share in the league, and the weighted age, 28.2, is the oldest. The quarterback room is Joe Burrow, Kirk Cousins (38.2), Baker Mayfield (31.6) and Aaron Rodgers (42.9). Burrow was the one riser, up 319.

The waiver work was small and smart. Chig Okonkwo ($6, 1,430) replaced Pat Freiermuth (1,292), and Colby Parkinson ($4) replaced Christian Kirk. The top of the roster is still elite: Gibbs (10,238), Ja'Marr Chase (8,336) and Puka Nacua (8,028) are three of the six most valuable players in the league.
The picks don't help much. Send Nudes owns two 2027 thirds, its own and Ben Football Team's, plus its own 2028 first, second and third. That's 6,760 in pick value, and no 2027 first or second.
breakdown.verdict: A title team with three young stars and a lot of value aging out around them.
breakdown.move: Sell one of the veteran quarterbacks, Cousins or Mayfield, while a contender still needs one, and push the 2028 first into the title run only for a starter under 27.

breakdown.headline: More Value in Picks Than Players, and a Quarterback Who Scored 28 on Thursday
p: ClutchJuice is 2-4, scores 91.0 a game, 11th, and is 10th in dynasty value at 51,614. The number that matters: its picks are worth 27,137, the most in the league, and its players are worth 24,477. No other team in the league has picks worth more than its roster.

The roster is built around Drake Maye (7,157), 24, who scored 28.44 on Thursday. Germie Bernard (2,362) gained 537 this week and Kyle Pitts Sr. (2,221) gained 337. Eighty-seven percent of the value is in players 25 or younger, the highest share in the league. On Tuesday it added Anthony Richardson Sr. (849) from Very Naughty Boys for its 2028 fifth-round pick.

Here's the pick list. In 2027: its own first (projected early, 5,103), brimley's and #StopAsianHate's firsts (both projected mid), its own, Panic Trade Project's and Jackie aCHANe's seconds, and #StopAsianHate's and Very Naughty Boys' thirds. In 2028: its own first and Sheev's first, its own second, and its own and brimley's thirds.
The projected win total is 2.6, which is fine. Every loss improves the 2027 first.
breakdown.verdict: The league's biggest pick stash, a starting quarterback, and not much else yet.
breakdown.move: Turn two of the three 2027 firsts into one young running back or receiver who's already producing. Three firsts in one draft is more than one roster can use.

breakdown.headline: The Toughest Schedule in the League, and Up to Fourth
p: brimley is 3-3 after two straight wins, scores 151.4 a game, fourth, and has faced 165.5 a game, the toughest schedule in the league. Its luck factor is -1.0. Dynasty value rose to 68,156, up one spot to fourth, and the projected win total is 8.6.

Malik Nabers (6,798), 23, is the most valuable player on the roster and gained 651 this week. Trey McBride (6,571) lost 500 and MarShawn Lloyd lost 438. Justin Jefferson (6,424) and two starting quarterbacks, Trevor Lawrence (5,973, on bye) and Jordan Love (4,682), round out the top.

One trade since last Sunday. On Monday night brimley sent Jonathon Brooks to Panic Trade Project for Tre Tucker (1,476), who starts this week. It also has Kendre Miller (947), an $8 pickup on Oct. 16. Saquon Barkley (3,084), 29, is questionable for Monday night, and DJ Moore (2,125) is out.

The draft capital is middle of the pack: its own 2027 second and third, Stroke The Post's 2027 third, its own 2028 first and second, and Sheev's 2028 third, 8,668, sixth. Its own 2027 first belongs to ClutchJuice from the Bucky Irving trade. Only 23% of the value is in players 25 or younger, second-lowest in the league.
breakdown.verdict: A better team than its record, with the schedule finally easing and an older roster than the rank suggests.
breakdown.move: Buy one starter at running back with the 2028 second. Don't sell: the scoring says this is a playoff team.

breakdown.headline: 4-3 With the League's Best Luck and a Pile of Picks
p: My sources say Panic Trade Project knows exactly what it is, and Friday's trade proves it. It sent Terrance Ferguson, an injured-reserve tight end, to Stroke The Post for Stroke's 2027 second-round pick. Ferguson had lost 161 in value since last Sunday. Panic got a pick worth 1,603 for a player now worth 1,616.

The standings say 4-3. The rest says rebuild. Panic scores 95.2 a game, 11th in the league, and its luck factor of +2.45 is the best in the league. The all-play record is 1.55 wins. It projects for 4.8 wins, and its lineup this week has four starters projected under 6.

Dynasty value is 57,598, seventh, and 84% of it is in players 25 or younger, second only to ClutchJuice. Too much of that value is hurt: Jaxson Dart (4,070) is on IR, and Carnell Tate (3,485) and Emeka Egbuka (3,228) are both out this week. Omar Cooper Jr. gained 343 and Makai Lemon gained 165. Jalen Coker lost 356 and Marvin Harrison Jr. lost 302.

The pick pile is the real asset: 17,519, third in the league. Panic owns two 2027 firsts (its own, projected mid, and Stroke The Post's, projected late), three 2027 seconds (Sheev's, Stroke The Post's and Ben Football Team's) and its own 2028 first, second and third, plus Stroke The Post's 2028 second and Jackie aCHANe's 2028 third.
breakdown.verdict: A rebuild with a lucky record. The Ferguson trade was the right instinct.
breakdown.move: Don't buy at 4-3. Package two of the three 2027 seconds to move up into the first round, and keep stashing young receivers.

breakdown.headline: Up Two Spots While Losing Value, and Getting Its Quarterback Back
p: #StopAsianHate climbed from fifth to third at 66,713, even though it lost 1,334. The teams around it lost more. That's the ranking equivalent of a stable patient on a ward where everyone else got worse.

The record undersells the team. It's 3-4 but fifth in scoring at 152.2 a game, with the third-toughest schedule and a luck factor of -2.0, second-worst in the league. Its all-play mark, 5.0 wins, says it should be 5-2. It projects for 7.7 wins.

Jaxon Smith-Njigba gained 483 and is worth 10,362, second in the league behind Josh Allen. Lamar Jackson (6,750) returns this week after three missed games, which fixes the quarterback problem that had Deshaun Watson starting alone. Kenneth Walker III lost 407 and is still worth 6,714. Jalen Hurts (3,325) is on injured reserve and RJ Harvey (1,580) is out, so the depth chart is thinner than the value says.

The future is mostly spent. The 2027 first belongs to ClutchJuice from the Cam Skattebo trade, and the 2028 first and second belong to Sheev from the Kenneth Walker III trade. What's left is its own 2027 second, two 2027 thirds (ClutchJuice's and Jackie aCHANe's) and its own 2028 third, 4,750 in all.
breakdown.verdict: A healthy Lamar and a top-two asset in Smith-Njigba make this a contender with a bad record, not a bad team.
breakdown.move: Stay in it. Use the 2027 second plus a bench back like Blake Corum to buy a starting tight end or receiver, and don't sell low on Hurts.

breakdown.headline: Six Wins, the Most Valuable Player in the League, and a First From God Bless Vodka
p: Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 is 6-0, the last unbeaten team, and first in dynasty value at 91,566. The gap to second-place Send Nudes is 17,941, which is about the value of Bijan Robinson and Brock Bowers combined. It scores 184.8 a game, best in the league, and its projected win total is now 13.5.

The roster is built at the top. Josh Allen (10,740) is the most valuable player in the league, and he's on the bench this week only because Buffalo has a bye. Bijan Robinson (10,074), 24, Bowers (7,666), 23, and Ashton Jeanty (5,617), 22, give it three young cornerstones. Amon-Ra St. Brown (7,489) gained 558 in value since last Sunday. The losses were at the edges: Davante Adams (IR) fell 682 and Michael Wilson 464.
Age is the one thing to watch. Thirty percent of the value is in players 29 or older: Allen and Christian McCaffrey are both 30.4, and Dak Prescott is 33.3. Only 34% is 25 or younger.

The draft capital covers it. Bijan holds God Bless Vodka's 2027 first, and with God Bless Vodka at 1-5, it currently projects early and is worth 5,103. It also has God Bless Vodka's 2027 second, its own 2028 first and second, and Ben Football Team's 2028 first and third. Its own 2027 first belongs to Jackie aCHANe. Pick value is 13,753, fifth. This week it spent $13 on Michael Mayer and $6 on Ryan Flournoy for depth.
breakdown.verdict: The best team in the league now, and an early first from a struggling team to restock later.
breakdown.move: Nothing big. Use the God Bless Vodka first or the Ben 2028 first to get younger at running back behind McCaffrey before his value falls further.

breakdown.headline: 0-6, Three 2027 Firsts, and a Tight End Who Just Got More Targets
p: Very Naughty Boys is 0-6, scores 86.0 a game, last, and projects for 0.8 wins. Clinically, that's the plan working. Dynasty value rose 2,262 to 56,246, eighth.

Three trades in two days this week. It sent Anthony Richardson Sr. to ClutchJuice for a 2028 fifth, sent Chris Godwin Jr. and Justin Fields to Ben Football Team for Dontayvion Wicks, and added Austin Ekeler from God Bless Vodka for a 2027 fourth. Wicks is out this week with an ankle injury. J.J. McCarthy gained 994 in value and Colston Loveland (3,955) gained 549. Loveland scored 19.9 on Thursday, and Cole Kmet's knee injury could make him Chicago's only real tight end.
Sixty-five percent of the value is in players 25 or younger. Fernando Mendoza (3,990) on the taxi squad is the most valuable player on the roster.

The draft capital is the second-best in the league at 22,515. Very Naughty Boys holds three 2027 firsts: its own and Sheev's, both projected early at 5,103 each, and Send Nudes' (projected late). It also holds Send Nudes', Bijan's and its own 2027 seconds, plus its own 2028 first, second and third. Its own 2027 third belongs to ClutchJuice.
breakdown.verdict: The cleanest tank in the league, with two early firsts and a third that's late.
breakdown.move: Keep selling veterans for picks. Package the Send Nudes first with a second to move up if a top quarterback prospect is there.

breakdown.headline: Sixth in Value, No 2027 Picks, and Still Buying
p: Stroke The Post is 4-3, but the scoring says contender. It averages 170.8 a game, third in the league, and its all-play record of 5.55 wins is second only to Bijan Your Face 🍆💦. The luck factor is -1.55. It projects for 9.6 wins.

The value went the other way. Stroke The Post lost 2,625 and sits sixth at 65,395. Jonathan Taylor lost 795, the biggest single drop on the roster, and Garrett Wilson (401), Chris Olave (387) and Travis Kelce (295) all fell too. Michael Penix Jr. was the one real gain, up 299. Only 19% of the value is in players 25 or younger, the lowest share in the league.

Friday's trade was about Kelce, who is 37. Stroke sent its own 2027 second to Panic Trade Project for Terrance Ferguson, a 23-year-old tight end now on the Rams' injured reserve. The price was fair on value, 1,603 for 1,616. The cost is that Stroke now owns no 2027 picks at all.
What's left is its own 2028 first and third, 3,241 in pick value, second-fewest in the league after Ben Football Team. Every future move will have to be paid for with players.
breakdown.verdict: A top-three offense with an aging core and no 2027 draft capital.
breakdown.move: Win now, because the roster is built for it. Sell an aging back like Jonathan Taylor or D'Andre Swift after the season, before their value falls further.

breakdown.headline: 5-1, the Luckiest Team in the League, and One Draft Pick Left
p: Ben Football Team is 5-1 and 12th in dynasty value at 42,362. Here's what I'm hearing from the scoring: 125.4 a game, seventh, against the third-softest schedule, 111.2 a game. All-play says 2.64 wins. The luck factor is +2.36, the highest in the league. The projected win total is still 8.6, because five wins are already in the bank.

It went for it again on Tuesday, adding Chris Godwin Jr. (1,218) and Justin Fields (359) from Very Naughty Boys for Dontayvion Wicks. Godwin starts this week with Baker Mayfield expected back. Patrick Mahomes (5,535) lost 382 in value this week; Rashid Shaheed gained 358 and DK Metcalf (2,004) gained 312.
The roster is old where it counts. Mahomes is 31 and Jared Goff 32, and 30% of the value is in players 29 or older. Sam LaPorta (3,499) and Bhayshul Tuten (3,483) are the young pieces.

The draft capital is gone. Ben holds one pick in the first three rounds of 2027 and 2028: its own 2028 second, 1,389, last in the league. Its 2027 first belongs to Sheev, its 2027 second to Panic Trade Project, its 2027 third to Send Nudes, and its 2028 first and third to Bijan.
breakdown.verdict: A real playoff team on paper, a much weaker one by the scoring, and no picks left to fix it.
breakdown.move: Stop buying. Any more veterans cost picks Ben doesn't have. Play out the season and hope the luck holds.

breakdown.headline: 4-2 on the Softest Schedule, and Two 2027 Firsts in the Drawer
p: Jackie aCHANe is 4-2 and rose two spots to ninth in dynasty value, 52,504. The scoring is 112.8 a game, eighth. It has faced 86.7 a game, the softest schedule in the league, and its luck factor is +2.0, second-highest. All-play says 2.0 wins. The projected win total is 6.4.

The value gain came from Matthew Golden (4,011), who gained 668. Terry McLaurin, 31, lost 589. De'Von Achane (3,969) is on IR with an ACL injury. Its own 2028 second belongs to God Bless Vodka.
Last week it lost to Send Nudes by 0.14. This week it gets Bijan. Thirty percent of the value is in players 25 or younger.
breakdown.verdict: A middling roster with a lucky record and good picks. The picks are the future here.
breakdown.move: Sell high while 4-2 still means something. Murray and Willis have value to a contender that needs a quarterback.

dynasty.method: Dynasty score = market value of every rostered player plus draft picks. Player values come from FantasyCalc's superflex, 12-team PPR dynasty market, which covers about 400 players and already prices in age; deeper depth players get a small estimate by years in the league. Pick values also come from FantasyCalc, with 2027 firsts valued early, mid or late by the original owner's current standing. Rosters and pick ownership come straight from Sleeper. Updated with each Sunday Edition. Projected wins add the current record to 7 remaining games, played at a rate that blends all-play win rate with a strength score (half points per game, half this week's lineup projection).

tradeGrades.headline: Stroke The Post Spends Its Last 2027 Pick on a Tight End Who Can't Play Yet
tradeGrades.intro: One new trade since Thursday's edition. On Friday morning, Panic Trade Project sent tight end Terrance Ferguson, who is on the Rams' injured reserve, to Stroke The Post for Stroke's 2027 second-round pick. I grade every trade three ways: value, fit and timing. Value is market price, using FantasyCalc's dynasty values for players and the same pick values as our Dynasty Rankings. Winning on value with the wrong timeline is still a bad trade. The four older trades keep the values and grades from the editions that graded them.

sides.reason: Stroke The Post got a 23-year-old tight end worth 1,616 for a pick worth 1,603, so the value is even. The fit makes sense on paper: Travis Kelce is 37 and Stroke needs his replacement. The timing is the problem. Ferguson is on the Rams' injured reserve with an ankle injury and can't help a 4-3 team now, and the deal used Stroke's last 2027 pick.

Panic Trade Project turned an injured tight end into a second-round pick at market price. Ferguson's value has dropped 161 since last Sunday. A 4-3 team with the league's best luck factor and the 11th-best scoring should be adding picks, and this is Panic's third 2027 second. It doesn't win the trade on value, but it wins on timing.

trades.title: Godwin and Fields to Ben Football Team

sides.reason: Ben Football Team won on market value by 378, Godwin at 1,142 and Fields at 276 for Wicks at 1,040. The fit is mixed. Godwin starts this week at 9.7 projected, but he averaged 7.7 in six starts for Very Naughty Boys, while Wicks averaged 9.8 in five starts for Ben. Fields is Kansas City's backup, and Ben starts Patrick Mahomes, so in superflex he's a sensible handcuff; Ben released Jameis Winston a minute after the trade. The timing works: Ben is 5-1 and 12th in dynasty value, so this is a team cashing in a season it's actually winning.

Very Naughty Boys gave up 378 in market value and got five years younger at receiver. For an 0-6 team that is eighth in dynasty value and owns three 2027 first-round picks, younger is the right direction, and Godwin's value only drops from here at 30. Wicks starts Monday night against Dallas at 6.35 projected. The knock is the price: it handed a contender a starter and a quarterback handcuff for a smaller return.

ClutchJuice paid a 2028 fifth-round pick for a 24-year-old quarterback worth 697. In superflex, that's about as cheap as a quarterback lottery ticket gets. Drake Maye is its only starting quarterback, and this week it has running back Demond Claiborne in the superflex slot at 0.64 projected. Richardson is Indianapolis's backup and has no Week 7 projection, so he doesn't fix that yet. At 2-4 and 11th in dynasty value, buying a young quarterback is the right move for this team.

FantasyCalc doesn't price fifth-round picks; its 2028 fourth is worth 845, so this pick is worth less than that. Richardson was a backup with no projection, and Very Naughty Boys still has Sam Darnold and Tanner McKee starting, so it didn't lose a lineup piece. But a rebuilding superflex team should be buying 24-year-old quarterbacks, not selling them for a fifth. Twelve minutes later it traded Fields too.

brimley gave up 90 in market value, Brooks at 1,407 for Tucker at 1,317, and that is close to even. The fit is strong: Romeo Doubs is on brimley's IR and DJ Moore is listed out, and Tucker scored 26.7 on Sunday and 78.5 in six starts this season. Brooks never scored for brimley and is on NFL injured reserve with an abdomen injury, per Sleeper. A 3-3 team holding sixth place turned a player it couldn't use into a starter, and took him from the team it is tied with.

Panic Trade Project won on value by 90 and got two years younger, which fits its rebuild ranking, seventh in dynasty value. The timing is the problem. It is 3-3, tied with brimley for the last playoff spot, and it sold its leading scorer to brimley hours after his best game, for a running back who can't play right now. Choosing to rebuild is fine. Doing it by strengthening the one team you are chasing, for a player you can't start, is a C.

Very Naughty Boys paid a pick worth 877 for a running back worth 531, a 346-point loss. Ekeler started immediately and scored 2.7 in a 0.54-point loss. The team is 0-6, ranks eighth in dynasty value and owns three 2027 first-round picks, so its window is next year, not a 31-year-old's last season. Because it is 0-6, its own fourth is likely to fall early in the round, which makes the price higher than the market average.

God Bless Vodka claimed Ekeler for $4 on Oct. 4. He scored 5.0 and 2.4 on its bench, and it sold him for a pick worth 877 and a 346-point gain in market value. At 1-5 and 11th in dynasty value, God Bless Vodka should be selling veterans, and this pick comes from the league's only winless team. It's a small deal, but it's done right.
